title: Enabling Voices: LLM-assisted screening pipeline for a scoping review of AI-assisted communication support in dementia and aphasia
description:
Archived deposit accompanying the scoping review Enabling Voices: AI-Assisted Communication Support for People with Dementia and Aphasia.

Contains the analysis code, the screening and extraction prompts, per-record model screening decisions with confidence scores and rationales, anonymised human annotations, the 120-record validation subset as drawn, the seed-stability check output, record-level corpus metadata, and a script that regenerates every reported inter-annotator agreement and screening-performance statistic from the deposited records.

Screening was performed with locally hosted, open-source models (Llama 3.1 8B and Qwen 2.5 7B) on institutional research computing infrastructure; no bibliographic or full-text data left the institution and no external API was used.

Licensing is dual: code under the MIT Licence, data and documentation under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International. Both licence texts are included in the archive as LICENSE and LICENSE-DATA.txt. The single licence field above records the terms applying to the data and documentation that make up the bulk of the deposit.

Full-text PDFs of screened records are not redistributed, for copyright reasons; records are identified by DOI so they can be retrieved independently.
